## `GET /audit`

Newest first; pass the last id as before\_id for the next page.

| Parameter   | In    | Type                | Required | Description                |
| ----------- | ----- | ------------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `limit`     | query | `integer`           | No       | ≥ 1; ≤ 500 Default: `100`. |
| `before_id` | query | `integer` or `null` | No       |                            |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [AuditEventView](/reference/api/models/#auditeventview)  |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /auth/login`

Signs in with a username and password and sets the session cookie.

**Request body:** [LoginRequest](/reference/api/models/#loginrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [UserView](/reference/api/models/#userview)                       |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /auth/logout`

Ends the current session.

| Status | Meaning             | Body |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None |

## `GET /auth/me`

Returns the signed-in user, their role and the actions it allows.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                        |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [UserView](/reference/api/models/#userview) |

## `POST /auth/password`

Needs the current password; signs out the user's other sessions.

**Request body:** [PasswordChange](/reference/api/models/#passwordchange) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /auth/sessions`

Lists the user's own sessions.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                       |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [SessionView](/reference/api/models/#sessionview) |

## `POST /auth/sessions/revoke-others`

Sign out everywhere else.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [RevokedSessions](/reference/api/models/#revokedsessions) |

## `DELETE /auth/sessions/{session_id}`

Ends one of the user's sessions.

| Parameter    | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ------------ | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `session_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /auth/setup`

Create the first admin with the setup token; 409 once any admin exists.

| Parameter                 | In     | Type               | Required | Description |
| ------------------------- | ------ | ------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `X-Servtuner-Setup-Token` | header | `string` or `null` | No       |             |

**Request body:** [SetupRequest](/reference/api/models/#setuprequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [UserView](/reference/api/models/#userview)                       |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /auth/status`

Reports the auth mode and whether setup is still required.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                            |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [AuthStatus](/reference/api/models/#authstatus) |

## `GET /users`

Lists users.

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                           |
| ------ | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [UserAdminView](/reference/api/models/#useradminview) |

## `PATCH /users/{user_id}`

| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `user_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [UserUpdate](/reference/api/models/#userupdate) (`application/json`)

| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [UserAdminView](/reference/api/models/#useradminview)             |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `DELETE /users/{user_id}/identities`

The subject is a query parameter: DNs hold commas and slashes.

| Parameter | In    | Type     | Required | Description            |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `user_id` | path  | `string` | Yes      |                        |
| `subject` | query | `string` | Yes      | at most 512 characters |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [UserAdminView](/reference/api/models/#useradminview)             |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
